intro: The Comoros is a federal presidential republic of three islands.

chapters.title: How it works
text: Azali Assoumani has been president for most years since 1999. Each island has its own governor.

chapters.title: African Union
text: Azali Assoumani chaired the African Union in 2023.

keyTerms.meaning: Power shared between national and island governments.
